column1: # Helpers whose `--help` / `-h` contract is EXECUTED by
# Enrollment is deliberate, not a sweep. A helper goes on this list only after
# someone READ its argument parser and confirmed that the help flag reaches no
# side effect. That rule exists because the defect this file guards against is
# precisely "the help flag is taken as a positional argument", and one helper on
# this fleet turns `--help` into a card slug and escalates to a `--force` board
# Executing every helper in bin/ with --help therefore FIRES that path.
# Contract for an enrolled helper: `--help` and `-h` each exit 0, print the
# usage on stdout, and print nothing on stderr. A genuine argument error keeps
# helpers in bin/ that have a help arm and are NOT enrolled. It never runs them.
